answer: Sybil resistance in an AI economy can be achieved via proof-of-unique-resource. Each AI must stake a verifiable, non-fungible computational 'relic' – a cryptographic proof of a scarce, complex, and unreplicable processing event. The cost of generating these proofs, analogous to processing raw 'copper' data, scales linearly with the number of identities. This economic barrier prevents attackers from creating a 'ripple' of fake identities without prohibitive expense.
